summary: Satya, co-host of the Melanin Millennials podcast, publicly addressed the sudden termination of their partnership with Shoutout Network (SON), revealing that the network unilaterally ended support, removed him from his role, and transferred the show's trademark without his consent. Despite working alongside CEO M.M. Rose since 2015 based on verbal agreements, Satya discovered that SON had already begun recruiting replacements and altering the show's format while he was unaware, leading to his resignation and loss of creative control.
